emails.description: Every email you commit with, including your GitHub noreply address.

output.description: The work-history Markdown file, relative to this config file.

canonical.description: Repos whose commits are copies of another repo's (a mirror or split), mapped to that repo. Their work is written up once, under the canonical repo.

approved.description: Repos the monthly run reads. The agent adds repos here when you approve a new project.

ignored.description: Repos the monthly run never reports as new projects.

backfill.description: Settings for `collect backfill`, which also reads local git clones.

projectsRoot.description: Folder that holds your local clones; ~ expands to your home folder.

localFolders.description: Folders under projectsRoot to scan for git repos, up to three levels deep.

noGit.description: Folders without git, reported with file dates only.

remote.description: owner/name for clones whose origin remote is missing or wrong, keyed by path under projectsRoot.

branches.description: Branches to read instead of the default branch, keyed by clone path or owner/name.

aliases.description: Renamed owners or repos: old/name or old/* to new/name or new/*.
